"""Add one separately reviewed native moon-source trail in this disposable world."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import connection,transaction
from evennia import create_object
from evennia.objects.models import ObjectDB
from pokemon.models.core import OwnedPokemon
from pokemon.data.generation import get_valid_moves
from pokemon.names import resolve_dex_entry
from pokemon.dex import POKEDEX
ART=Path(r"H:\PokemonFusionProject\fusion2-necrozma-items\.codex-artifacts\item-release-860-20261025")
RELEASE=ART/"released"
plan=json.loads((RELEASE/"plan.json").read_text())
config=json.loads((RELEASE/"runtime-private.json").read_text())
assert plan["candidate"]==config["candidate"] and plan["tag"]==config["tag"]
assert Path(settings.GAME_DIR).resolve()==Path(plan["source"]).resolve()
with connection.cursor() as cursor:
    cursor.execute("SELECT current_schema()")
    assert cursor.fetchone()[0]==config["schema"]
assert resolve_dex_entry(POKEDEX,"Lunala")
assert "moongeistbeam" in get_valid_moves("Lunala",50)
center=ObjectDB.objects.get(db_key="Item Repair QA Center",db_tags__db_key=plan["tag"])
assert not ObjectDB.objects.filter(db_location=center,db_key="lunala trail").exists()
before=list(OwnedPokemon.objects.order_by("pk").values())
with transaction.atomic():
    room=create_object("typeclasses.rooms.Room",key="Item Repair Lunala Trail")
    room.db.allow_hunting=True
    room.db.npc_chance,room.db.encounter_rate=0,100
    room.db.noitem,room.db.tp_cost=True,0
    room.db.hunt_chart=[{"name":"Lunala","min_level":50,"max_level":50,"weight":1}]
    entrance=create_object("typeclasses.exits.Exit",key="lunala trail",location=center,destination=room)
    returning=create_object("typeclasses.exits.Exit",key="center",location=room,destination=center)
    for obj in (room,entrance,returning):obj.tags.add(plan["tag"])
assert list(OwnedPokemon.objects.order_by("pk").values())==before
(RELEASE/"staff-moon-source.json").write_text(json.dumps({"candidate":plan["candidate"],"tag":plan["tag"],"objects":[o.pk for o in (room,entrance,returning)],"native_species":"Lunala","level":50,"ownership_unchanged":True,"pokemon_grants":0,"permanent":False},indent=2)+"\n")
print("ITEM_REPAIR_QA_MOON_SOURCE_READY",room.pk,"zero Pokemon grants")

"""Send only the published separate operator controls into this disposable game."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
ART=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RELEASE=ART/"released"
mode=sys.argv[1]
if mode=="world":
    pre=""
    path=ART/"world.py"
elif mode=="moon-source":
    pre=""
    path=ART/"moon_source.py"
elif mode=="runtime":
    label=sys.argv[2]
    assert re.fullmatch("[a-z0-9-]+",label)
    pre="QA_LABEL="+repr(label)+"; "
    path=ART/"runtime.py"
elif mode=="prerequisite":
    player,key,action=sys.argv[2:5]
    config=json.loads((RELEASE/"player-private.json").read_text())
    assert player in config
    assert re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f-]{36}",key)
    assert action in {"faint","deplete-pp"}
    pre="QA_PLAYER="+repr(config[player]["name"])+"; QA_POKEMON="+repr(key)+"; QA_ACTION="+repr(action)+"; "
    if action=="deplete-pp":pre+="QA_SLOT="+str(int(sys.argv[5]))+"; "
    path=ART/"prerequisites.py"
else:raise SystemExit("world/runtime/prerequisite only")
command="@py exec(compile("+repr(pre)+"+open("+repr(str(path))+", encoding='utf-8').read(), "+repr(str(path))+", 'exec'), globals())"
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B",str(RELEASE/"staff_transport.py"),"command",command],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8")
(ART/(mode+"-"+(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else "setup")+"-transport.log")).write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr,encoding="utf-8")
print(result.stdout[-3500:])
assert result.returncode==0
marker={"world":"ITEM_REPAIR_QA_WORLD_READY","moon-source":"ITEM_REPAIR_QA_MOON_SOURCE_READY","runtime":"ITEM_REPAIR_RUNTIME_OBSERVED","prerequisite":"ITEM_REPAIR_LABELLED_PREREQUISITE"}[mode]
assert marker in result.stdout,result.stdout[-3000:]
